Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 23-Nov-2025 (09:30 AM - 12:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  FIFTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - NOVEMBER 2025  
  Advanced Computer Networks [CSE_5151]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                   Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1)                A rescue team utilises UAVs to establish communication links in disaster areas. Analyse how UAV       (5)  
  networks differ from MANETs and VANETs in handling mobility and topology changes.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           A logistics company operates delivery drones across multiple urban zones. Apply a suitable UAV        (5)  
  network topology to ensure efficient communication and justify your choice.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
2)                A cloud service provider experiences delays due to manual configuration of numerous network           (5)  
  devices. Explain with appropriate reasoning, how Software-Defined Networking (SDN) automation  
  A)           addresses the challenges of traditional network management.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           An organisation wants to integrate its existing legacy network into an SDN environment. Apply         (5)  
  Cisco ACI's policy extension mechanisms to achieve unified management across old and new  
  systems.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
3)                A financial firm wants to consolidate servers to reduce power consumption and idle capacity.          (5)  
  Analyse how compute virtualisation transforms server utilization and operational efficiency.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           A global IT enterprise plans to virtualise both compute and storage resources. Apply the principles   (5)  
  of Software Defined Storage to unify heterogeneous storage systems.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
4)                A mobile user experiences sudden drops in video quality while watching over 4G. Apply DASH            (5)  
  which adapts video bitrates to maintain seamless streaming under fluctuating bandwidth.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           A video-conferencing system struggles with lip-sync mismatches. Apply RTP timestamping and            (5)  
  synchronisation methods to align audio and video streams.  
  
  
  Page #1

Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
5)                        A router must distribute bandwidth fairly between video and file-transfer traffic. Evaluate the        (5)  
  effectiveness of Weighted Fair Queuing (WFQ) in maintaining fairness and delay control.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)                A healthcare data system requires continuous uptime despite regional fiber faults. Explain how self- (5)  
  healing ring architectures restore connectivity automatically to prevent service interruption  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"
